notes: Lead closed as (a) in-definition base record. Evidence: Vaia Euless welder posting names 'MICA Steelworks Euless, Texas Plant' (night shift 3:30 PM - 2:00 AM; flux core/metal core wire; steel components; UT passable welds); Vaia Euless Production Helper posting ('fitting and welding'); JobTarget Euless Production Helper listing live; EPA FRS 110070704100 'MICA STEELWORKS EULESS', 3501 House Anderson Rd, SIC 3441, industrial storm water permits 2020/2021; MICA contact page lists 'EULESS OFFICE' at the same address (label discounted: Kaufman is also 'OFFICE' yet a TxDOT pole plant). Tallo: MICA 'Welder - 2nd shift', Euless Texas Plant, posted Oct 13, 2026, expires 12/13/2026 (live); Tallo also showed an Industrial Maintenance Mechanic- 2nd Shift at Euless (posted Jun 13, 2026, no longer available). MICA careers page has no location list (applications via Indeed, not fetched because Indeed blocks page fetches). Negatives: Euless is not in the AISC snapshot (only MICA Haltom City and Kaufman, lines 2811/2813), not on TxDOT hmip, osb, itspoles or tsp lists, and no current source states the Euless product mix (products/tier inferred company-level). Weld process and welder posting facts are left for profiling (profile columns empty). New leads, not checked: Vaia shows MICA postings at Rhome, TX (Material Handler, Inventory Handler, Metal Fabrication Support Technician); Rhome is not in plants.csv.
